title: Bilt by stoopid enguneers
text:
Bilt by stoopid enguneers. The basic things I need in a toaster are:
1. Four slice at a time capacity
2. Wide enough slots for bagels or thick slices of bread
3. Cancel button to stop toasting when necessary
4. Cool-touch sides
5. Crumb tray for cleaning
6. Aesthetically pleasing design

This model has all of the above, so I should be ecstatically happy, except:
1. Due to a design oversight, the toasted product doesn't pop up far enough to allow you to remove it without risking burns or serious injury. Forget toasting smaller items like English muffins or waffles that are slightly bent out of shape.
2. The "frozen" feature is designed to evenly brown items like waffles that you use straight out of the freezer. This doesn't work - period. Waffles toast with burned middles and untoasted ends, or vice versa.
3. The bagel feature needs some experimentation with the settings before you get it right. The lower settings don't really do very much, and the higher settings can make charcoal.
4. Due to another design oversight, thin slices of bread or small items can get trapped by the inner grill thingy, causing the food to get jammed in the toaster.

Summary:
If regular machine-sliced bread is all you need to toast, then this toaster will work for you. The "cancel" button is a definite plus, and it fills all the basic needs as above.
For all else - fuggedabouddit.

Amanda Richards, October 7, 2011

features: Special Functions - Press the frozen or bagel buttons and the toaster will automatically adjust to provide ideal results. Plus, the cancel button pops the toaster at any time
Slide-Out Crumb Tray - Keep the counter clean and the kitchen smelling fresh. The crumb tray lets you remove crumbs before they burn or end up on the counter
Sleek Design - The efficient design won’t cramp your countertop or your style
850-Watts - Fast toasting with precise results thanks to 850-watts of power
Extra-Wide Toasting Slots - Add a delicious crunch to bagels, thick breads, and more. The extra-wide slots accommodate all types of toasted treats
description: Breakfast just got easier. The BLACK+DECKER 2-Slice Toaster is the perfect way to start your day, with six timed shade settings and special functions for bagels and frozen items. Plus, the extra-wide slots easily fit bagels, thick artisan breads, and more.
